description: This file defines the SimpleTextFragment class for an Android application. The class extends Fragment and manages a TextView, allowing the fragment to display customizable text passed via arguments or programmatically. It includes methods to process arguments, set text content, and retrieve the TextView for further modifications.

classes.name: SimpleTextFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a single TextView with customizable text, used for tutorial pages in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the TextView for this fragment, setting its text based on arguments or default state.

methods.name: getTextView
methods.description: Returns the TextView managed by this fragment.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Updates the text of the TextView with a string resource ID.

methods.name: processArguments
methods.description: Processes fragment arguments to set the internal text or text resource ID.
